facts.statement: The genus Petalodus was named by Richard Owen in 1840.
The type species of the genus is Petalodus hastingsii.
facts.quote: The genus was named by Richard Owen in 1840 and the type species is Petalodus hastingsii.

facts.statement: The genus is known from teeth that are subtriangular to rhomboidal in shape.
facts.quote: known from subtriangular to rhomboidal teeth

facts.statement: Petalodus lived during the Pennsylvanian and Permian periods.
facts.quote: from the Pennsylvanian to the Permian

facts.statement: Petalodus lived between 346.7 and 264.9 million years ago, from the Visean to the Wordian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Visean to Wordian (346.7 to 264.9 million years ago)

facts.statement: Petalodus belongs to the family Petalodontidae.
Petalodus is classified in the class Chondrichthyes.

rejected.statement: Petalodus is an extinct genus of cartilaginous fish.
rejected.quote: Petalodus is an extinct genus of cartilaginous fish
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'Petalodus is an extinct genus of cartilaginous fish'
